author: Marlon Chaviano
name: saas-rails
title: SaaS with Rails
description: Rails 8 for a SaaS: authentication with the official generator, Tailwind CSS, Hotwire and the Solid stack (cache, queues and websockets without Redis).

base.command: command -v rails >/dev/null || { echo 'Rails is required: gem install rails' >&2; exit 1; }; rails new {{name}} --css tailwind --skip-git --skip-bundle --skip-kamal --skip-thruster

verify.command: bin/rails db:prepare && bin/rails test && bin/rails zeitwerk:check && (test ! -d spec || bundle exec rspec)

instructions:
## How to work here

- The session is handled by the `Authentication` concern (`app/controllers/concerns/`); protect every controller and use `allow_unauthenticated_access` only where needed.
- UI with Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus) and Tailwind: before adding JavaScript, see whether Turbo Frames or Streams solve it.
- Before finishing: `bin/rails test`.
